items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Gator & Ben interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: especially with some parts that Jeremy has written... Jeremy works really hard constantly working on how things would go together then checks in with us... I have my guitars split a little bit so I have a little bit more of Jeremy on the right

ctx.x: How much of the bass lines you conceive and play — I’m trying to figure out how to ask this question — are actually connected to the chord symbol and the scales that might go with it? Do you think that way or are you more of an ear player?

Well I started out much more of an ear player, and just sort of taking the same shape over different root chords, so I learned from my bass teacher, Dave DeMarco, the blues pentatonic scale and just kind of threw that shape over everything. I actually started on piano so I learned, you know, the Suzuki method and you know scales a little bit on piano so when I put it on bass I saw it as more of a pattern rather than the notes on a piano. And I overlayed it a bit in my head but I got a lot of mileage out of just…
